blogs.title: TAV-in-TAV-in-TAV: When Three is the New Two
blogs.description: Why repeat transcatheter aortic valve replacements are becoming inevitable and how to decide when a third intervention is worth the risks. This post explores patient selection, surgical risk scores, and the evolving role of TAVI in an aging prosthesis population.

blogs.title: Imaging‑First Strategy: CT Planning to Prevent Coronary Obstruction in Multi‑Valve Reinterventions
blogs.description: Step‑by‑step of the pre‑procedural CT workflow used in a triple‑valve case: measuring coronary ostial height, sinus dimensions, valve‑to‑coronary distances, and predicting neo‑skirt effects. Includes tips on contouring, 3‑D modelling, and decision points for coronary protection.

blogs.title: Commissural Alignment and Effective Orifice Area: The Fine Art of Valve Placement
blogs.description: An in‑depth look at how aligning the new valve’s commissures with the previous frames can preserve coronary flow, reduce valve‑patient mismatch, and optimize hemodynamics. Practical guidance on using fluoroscopic landmarks and CT data to guide depth and rotation.

blogs.title: Managing Prosthetic Valve Endocarditis in a Transcatheter‑Redirection Era
blogs.description: Exploring the controversial use of TAVI after treated infective endocarditis. Discuss guideline recommendations, infection‑control criteria, and the balance between surgical and percutaneous options in patients with high operative risk.

blogs.title: Long‑Term Surveillance After Serial TAVI: What the Data Tell Us
blogs.description: A review of follow‑up strategies for patients who’ve had TAV‑in‑TAV‑in‑TAV, focusing on imaging intervals, functional assessment, and early detection of restenosis or paravalvular leak. Includes pearls on echocardiographic indices and new non‑invasive biomarkers.

blogs.title: Future‑Proofing Coronary Access After Multiple Stent‑Frames
blogs.description: Challenges of coronary intervention when three transcatheter valves reside in the aortic root. Discuss techniques such as BASILICA, intentional valve fracture, and evolving access tools, plus how to plan for potential downstream PCI in patients with prior CAD.
